description: This file is a test script for validating the 'NetworkAccess' parameter of the CMAgent module in a RDKB environment. It uses the tdklib library to set and get parameter values, executing test steps and validating responses.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A wrapper class provided by the tdklib library to facilitate scripting tests against TDK components.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with target IP, port, and test case name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks if the required module loads successfully.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test functions.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified module after test completion.
